Maria (Sales): Kicking off POC benchmark for Aegis prospect. Needs a mixed workload: embeddings + chat gen at ~500 qps sustained, plus 99.9 tail latency targets for chat. Who will own the test harness and customer-facing runbook?

Jake (Solutions): I can own the runbook. Proposed two-phase approach: 1) throughput soak (60m @ target qps) to validate sustained capacity, 2) tail-latency stress with synthetic cache-miss spikes. Tools: k6 for traffic shaping + our internal load-generator binary. Configs: model=redwood-1.3-large, gen_seq=256 tokens, batch_sizes=[8,16,32], payload mix=70% chat-gen / 30% embed.

Samir (Eng): I'll provision a Dedicated pool for the run (reserve 2h). Ops notes: please warm KV cache for 5m before ramp, enable continuous batching and request coalescing. Swarm suggestion: workers=18, concurrency_per_worker=12, prewarm_replicas=4. Watch for KV refresh events — they produce high-tail latency.

Lydia (Security): Blocker check: will test payloads contain any customer PII? If yes, we need sanitized payloads and to run in customer zone or with masked logs. Also need to complete security questionnaire section Q12 (encryption at rest/in transit + KMS ownership) before publishing results externally. Flag any logs with raw user text.

Maria (Sales): We'll request masked payload samples. Alan (AE) can you confirm they can provide sanitized samples by EOD tomorrow?

Alan (AE): Confirmed the customer agreed to provide sanitized samples. They're also asking for an estimate of incremental cost for a 2h Dedicated run vs a short reserved burst.

Jake (Solutions): Rough estimate: 2h Dedicated run is largely proportional to GPU-time. For a sustained 500 qps on this model expect ~1.0-1.5 GPU-hours per minute depending on batching — ballpark ~120-180 GPU-hours total for the run with warmups. Add 25-30% headroom for prewarm and spikes. I'll include a cost breakdown in the runbook.

Samir (Eng): Quick update from a test on dev cluster (soak #1): sustained 510 qps for 60m ✅. Observed 99.9 latency ~4.2s on cache-miss windows (~1.5-2% of requests). Correlation with KV refresh events. Logs snippet: 
```
[2025-06-02T09:14:02Z] request_id=abc123 q=510 latency=88ms cache_miss=false
[2025-06-02T09:47:08Z] request_id=def456 q=510 latency=4210ms cache_miss=true
```
I'll attach histograms and heatmaps in the writeup.

Maria (Sales): Can we get a short remediation/recommendation section for the customer and a one-slide summary showing cost impact + risk plan for the tail spikes?

Samir (Eng): Recommendations: increase KV prewarm TTL, enable request coalescing, prefer batch_size=16 for gen-heavy mix, and add a small warm pool to absorb cold-KV spikes. Plan to re-run tail stress after changes.

Lydia (Security): When you share logs/writeup, strip raw user text and mark synthetic identifiers. Send the sanitized artifacts to me for the questionnaire pass. Also note any KMS key IDs used in the run.

deploy-bot: deploy:redwood-test-bench -> success at 2025-06-02T09:00:00Z :rocket:

Maria (Sales): Plan: execute second pass tomorrow 09:00 PT after the config updates, produce customer-facing PDF + cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. Alan I'll loop you in the final deck.

Jake (Solutions): Runbook draft (internal): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/aegis-poc-bench — will update with cost table, scripts, and post-run checklist.
